records.jp: こころの学校って水泳の授業あった？
records.en_original: Did your school have a swimming class, Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Did your school have a swimming class, Kokoro?
records.en: Did your school have a swimming class, Kokoro?

records.jp: えーと……高校は、一応。<CR>中学までは学校にプールなかったから
records.en_original: Umm... My high school did, sort of. My middle school didn't have a pool.
records.en_auxiliary: Umm... My high school did, sort of. My middle school didn't have a pool.
records.en: Um... My high school did, technically.<CR>There was no pool at my school through middle school.

records.jp: へえー。<CR>それじゃ、もしかして泳ぐの苦手だったりする？
records.en_original: Huh. Then are you maybe not a great swimmer?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh. Then are you maybe not a great swimmer?
records.en: Oh.<CR>Then are you perhaps not very good at swimming?

records.jp: ううん。授業はなかったけど、<CR>小さいときは近所の川で友達と遊んだりしてたから
records.en_original: Oh, no. I may have not had it at school, but I used to play in the river with my friends when I was little.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, no. I may have not had it at school, but I used to play in the river with my friends when I was little.
records.en: No. We did not have classes, but when I was little,<CR>I used to play in the nearby river with my friends.

records.jp: おおー……野生児エピソード
records.en_original: Oh... So you were a wild child, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... So you were a wild child, huh?
records.en: Oh... So you were a wild child, huh?

records.jp: えっと……わたし、もしかしてバカにされてる？
records.en_original: Um... Are you making fun of me?
records.en_auxiliary: Um... Are you making fun of me?
records.en: Um... Are you making fun of me?

records.jp: いや、今のこころからはあんまり想像できない<CR>っていうか……。結構やんちゃな子供だったのかなって
records.en_original: No, it's just hard to picture you like that... Were you mischievous as a kid?
records.en_auxiliary: No, it's just hard to picture you like that... Were you mischievous as a kid?
records.en: No, it is just hard to imagine from how you are now...<CR>I wondered whether you were quite a mischievous child.

records.jp: んー……どっちかというと、<CR>友達に引っ張られるままって感じだったけど
records.en_original: Hmm... I think I mostly just wanted to do what all the other kids were doing.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I think I mostly just wanted to do what all the other kids were doing.
records.en: Hmm... I think I mostly just<CR>wanted to do what all the other kids were doing.

records.jp: そういうの、漫画みたいで羨ましいなあ
records.en_original: I'm jealous. Sounds like something out of a manga!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm jealous. Sounds like something out of a manga!
records.en: I'm jealous. Sounds like something out of a manga!

records.jp: そうかなあ？
records.en_original: You think so?
records.en_auxiliary: You think so?
records.en: You think so?

records.jp: 自然の中で遊ぶ機会って中々ないしね。<CR>そういう子供時代ってちょっと憧れちゃうよ
records.en_original: Most people don't really get to play out in nature like that. You must have had a great childhood!
records.en_auxiliary: Most people don't really get to play out in nature like that. You must have had a great childhood!
records.en: You do not get many chances to play out in nature.<CR>I kind of admire a childhood like that.

records.jp: うーん……わたしはプールで泳ぐ方が好きだなあ
records.en_original: Mm... I think I actually prefer swimming in a pool.
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... I think I actually prefer swimming in a pool.
records.en: Mm... I think I actually prefer swimming in a pool.

records.jp: ……今思うと、ちょっと恥ずかしいし
records.en_original: It's a little embarrassing to think about now...
records.en_auxiliary: It's a little embarrassing to think about now...
records.en: It's a little embarrassing to think about now...

records.jp: そんなに恥ずかしがることないと思うけどなあ
records.en_original: I don't think there's anything to be embarrassed about.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think there's anything to be embarrassed about.
records.en: I don't think there's anything to be embarrassed about.

records.jp: それがプールの授業もなかったし、<CR>水着とか、みんな持ってなくて……
records.en_original: Well, since there was no swimming class, no one had actual swimwear...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, since there was no swimming class, no one had actual swimwear...
records.en: Well, since there was no swimming class,<CR>no one had actual swimwear...

records.jp: も、もしかして……
records.en_original: D-do you mean...
records.en_auxiliary: D-do you mean...
records.en: D-do you mean...

records.jp: パンツいっちょで、水遊び
records.en_original: We played in the river in our underwear.
records.en_auxiliary: We played in the river in our underwear.
records.en: We played in the water wearing only our underwear.

records.jp: おお……
records.en_original: Ohh...
records.en_auxiliary: Ohh...
records.en: Ohh...

records.jp: まあまあ、子どもの時のことだから……。<CR>今さら恥ずかしがってもしょうがないよ！
records.en_original: Well, you were just kids. There's no point in being embarrassed about it now!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, you were just kids. There's no point in being embarrassed about it now!
records.en: Come on, you were children...<CR>There is no point being embarrassed about it now!

records.jp: ……そうだね。うん、そうだよね
records.en_original: Yes... I suppose, you're right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes... I suppose, you're right.
records.en: Yes... I suppose, you're right.

records.jp: こころの意外な一面が知れて、ちょっと嬉しいし！
records.en_original: I'm glad I got to learn about a different side of you!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad I got to learn about a different side of you!
records.en: I'm glad I got to learn about a different side of you!

records.jp: もう……。他の人に言いふらさないでね？
records.en_original: Jeez... You won't tell anyone, will you?
records.en_auxiliary: Jeez... You won't tell anyone, will you?
records.en: Jeez... You won't tell anyone, will you?

records.jp: はあい
records.en_original: My lips are sealed!
records.en_auxiliary: My lips are sealed!
records.en: My lips are sealed!

records.jp: 私もちょっと混ざりたかった……
records.en_original: I wish I'd been there...
records.en_auxiliary: I wish I'd been there...
records.en: I kind of wish I could have joined you...

records.jp: な、何言ってるの……？<CR>愛央ちゃんのえっち……
records.en_original: Wh-what are you saying, Ao? How naughty...
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what are you saying, Ao? How naughty...
records.en: W-what are you saying...?<CR>You pervert, Ao-chan...

records.jp: え！？　違う違う！<CR>こころと一緒に川遊びとかしたかったなーって話！
records.en_original: Huh?! No, not like that! I just wanted to play in the river with you!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?! No, not like that! I just wanted to play in the river with you!
records.en: Huh!? No, no!<CR>I meant I wish I could have played in the river with you!

records.jp: 決して変な意味はないからね！
records.en_original: I didn't mean it in a weird way!
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't mean it in a weird way!
records.en: I didn't mean it in a weird way!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんがそう言うなら……そういうことにしとく
records.en_original: Whatever you say...
records.en_auxiliary: Whatever you say...
records.en: If you say so, Ao-chan...

records.jp: ……せっかくプールに来たんだし、<CR>何もせずに帰るのももったいないよね
records.en_original: Well now that we're here, it seems like a waste just to leave without doing anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Well now that we're here, it seems like a waste just to leave without doing anything.
records.en: ...Since we came all the way to the pool,<CR>it would be a waste to leave without doing anything.

records.jp: よーし。じゃあ、あの頃を思い出して、<CR>ぱぱーっと脱いでプールで遊んじゃう？
records.en_original: So... Why not pretend like we're back at the river near your house and go for a quick skinny dip!
records.en_auxiliary: So... Why not pretend like we're back at the river near your house and go for a quick skinny dip!
records.en: All right. Then why do we not remember those days,<CR>strip right down, and play in the pool?

records.jp: 今なら誰も見てないし！
records.en_original: No one's watching!
records.en_auxiliary: No one's watching!
records.en: No one's watching!

records.jp: ……しないよ？
records.en_original: Absolutely not.
records.en_auxiliary: Absolutely not.
records.en: Absolutely not.

records.jp: プールで遊ぶなら、ちゃんと水着持ってこなきゃ。<CR>子どもじゃないんだから
records.en_original: We're not kids anymore. We have to wear swimsuits to go in the pool.
records.en_auxiliary: We're not kids anymore. We have to wear swimsuits to go in the pool.
records.en: If we want to play in the pool, we need to bring proper swimsuits.<CR>We are not children anymore.

records.jp: ですよねー……
records.en_original: Yeah, you're right...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you're right...
records.en: Yeah, you're right...

records.jp: 足をつけるくらいなら……いいかな。どう？
records.en_original: Why don't we just dip our toes in?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we just dip our toes in?
records.en: Why don't we just dip our toes in?

records.jp: ふふ、賛成
records.en_original: Hehe, sounds good.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, sounds good.
records.en: Hehe, sounds good.

records.jp: ふう……冷たくてきもちいい
records.en_original: Ooh... The water's nice and cool! That feels good.
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh... The water's nice and cool! That feels good.
records.en: Ooh... The water's nice and cool! That feels good.

records.jp: そうだねえ……
records.en_original: It does, doesn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: It does, doesn't it?
records.en: It does, doesn't it?

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
